label: TP
reason: The code performs URL decoding on user input and passes it to the response writer. While it attempts to mitigate XSS by replacing the last character of the parameter with 'Z', this is an insufficient mitigation strategy. Attackers can bypass this by constructing payloads that do not rely on the last character (e.g., appending safe characters or exploiting browser auto-closure of unclosed tags). Additionally, parameters with length <= 1 are not sanitized at all.

evidence.note: Data flows through URL decode: java.net.URLDecoder.decode(param, "UTF-8")
Weak mitigation: replace(...) modifies only the last character of the string to 'Z'
